****SOC Case Report****

**Case ID:** adibB2nqvTSZm99SQ — Probes and Recon - Potential APT Scanning
**Severity:** Critical
**Detection Date:** 2025-11-15
**Detection Source:** EDR, Proxy, Abnormal DNS Beacon, CASB
**Host:** APP-SC-PORTAL-02 , ENG-RND-01 ,WIN-ANALYTICS-07
**User/Account:** assets@afs.com

**Detection Details:**
On 11/16/2025, Pompano SOC identified and contained a highly automated intrusion attributed to a Chinese-state linked threat group known as Silver Lotus. The actors used a series of AI 'sub-agents' to automate vulnerability scanning, exploit development, data classification, and exfiltration with minimal human supervision. The operation targeted a DHS-component public-facing portal and internal LES environment. While Silver Lotus successfully breached the network and access limited internal data, their attempt to exfiltrate proprietary CUI and LES data was disrupted mid-transfer after anomaly detection triggered a containment response. It was determined that a compromised LES portal account was used to laterally move in the environment. The threat actor used automated credential testing by Claude sub-agents. The data exposed was a partial directory listing of folders; no confirmed data exfiltration beyond 3MB was observed. The forensic team is conducting analysis of the affected assets.

**Incident Timeline:**
- (2025-11-15 23:48:00 UTC) — Automated AI recon detected: "Claude-scanner" sub-agent probing public facing site API endpoints at ~1 requests per second from an external IP.
- (2025-11-16 00:37:00 UTC) — Valid credentials identified; portal access achieved.
- (2025-11-16 01:02:00 UTC) — Claude auto-generated custom payload exploiting unpatched input-validation bug (CVE-2025-53221) on portal backend -- executed arbitrary commands.
- (2025-11-16 01:40:00 UTC) — Lateral movement into internal network through VPN tunnel; enumeration of file shares begins.
- (2025-11-16 02:10:00 UTC) — Automated classification and tagging of sensitive files (using Claude's "priority classifer" agent).
- (2025-11-16 02:22:00 UTC) — Outbound traffic to C2 'intel-relay[.]ccnet-ai[.]top detected; auto block rule engaged.
- (2025-11-16 02:26:00 UTC) — SOC Critical Alert: High volume of small encrypted packets to rare domain. IR Team invoked containment playbook.
- (2025-11-16 02:33:00 UTC) — VPN Session terminated; R&D server segmented; packet capture initiated.
- (2025-11-16 04:10:00 UTC) — IR Team confirm AI-generated automation logs with prompt signatures referencing "Claude agentic modules".
- (2025-11-16 06:00:00 UTC) — Containment complete; IOC correlation with Silver Lotus confirmed via threat intel feeds.
- (2025-11-16 06:30:00 UTC) — Removed malicious agent artifacts and cleared AI-generated task queues. Disabled compromised accounts and rotated all service passwords.
- (2025-11-16 17:22:00 UTC) — Restored portal from clean backup. Applied patch for CVE-2025-53221.

****Triage:****
- **Host:** APP-SC-PORTAL-02 , ENG-RND-01 ,WIN-ANALYTICS-07
- **User/Account:** assets@afs.com
- **Source Name:** Pompano (UID: pompano-9fc38)
- **User Info:** assets@afs.com
- **Case URL:** https://swimlane.assets.accenturefederaldemo.com:443/account/f3349d75-6783-4a74-9c3c-76f396e19e9a/tenant/679bd671-c2de-4d6d-b1f0-91f0d65406ce/record/aEza_JJOovvdR3rIX/adibB2nqvTSZm99SQ

**Actions Taken:**
- **Blocked in EDR:** The Endpoint Detection and Response agent was used to block malicious processes or files associated with the threat actor on the affected hosts.
- **Blocked in Firewall:** The threat actor's Command & Control IP addresses and domains were blocked at the network perimeter to prevent further communication.
- **Collected Image:** A forensic disk image was collected from affected systems for in-depth analysis and evidence preservation.
- **Isolated Host:** Affected hosts were disconnected from the network to prevent lateral movement and contain the threat.
- **Quarantined File:** Malicious files and payloads generated by the threat actor were moved to a secure quarantine location by security tools.

**Recommended Remediations:**
- **AI Detection Readiness:** Develop and deploy signatures to detect the unique headers or traffic patterns of AI agent toolkits.
- **Behavioral detection:** Enhance SIEM rule logic to alert on anomalous bursts of activity, such as a single user session making an unusually high number of API calls in a short period.
- **Outbound filtering:** Implement stricter egress filtering rules to only allow DNS and HTTP/S traffic to known, trusted domains. Enforce proxy inspection and blocking for domains registered within the last 60 days.

**Artifacts:**
- **Network/Host:** APP-SC-PORTAL-02, ENG-RND-01, WIN-ANALYTICS-07, C2 Domain: intel-relay[.]ccnet-ai[.]top, Vulnerability: CVE-2025-53221
- **Process:** "Claude-scanner" sub-agent, "priority classifier" agent, AI-generated custom payloads, AI agentic modules
- **Account/User:** assets@afs.com, Compromised LES portal account

****Tools & Queries Run:****
**Splunk Correlation Query:**
```splunk
index=proxy sourcetype="web:access" |search user_agent="Claude-Recon*" OR user_agent="Claude-Exec*" |where count > 100 within 1m
```

**MITRE ATT&CK Mapping:**
- **Initial Access (TA0001):**
    - **T1190 - Exploit Public-Facing Application:** The actor exploited an unpatched vulnerability (CVE-2025-53221) on the public-facing web portal to gain entry.
    - **T1078.004 - Cloud Accounts:** The attacker used a compromised portal account to authenticate and gain further access.
- **Execution (TA0002):**
    - **T1059.003 - Windows Command Shell:** The exploit allowed the actor to execute arbitrary commands on the portal backend.
- **Discovery (TA0007):**
    - **T1082 - System Information Discovery:** The attacker performed enumeration of file shares after gaining access to the internal network.
- **Exfiltration (TA0010):**
    - **T1041 - Exfiltration Over C2 Channel:** The actor attempted to exfiltrate classified files through an encrypted channel to a rare C2 domain.

**Lessons Learned / Actions Taken:**
- Eradication involved removing AI agent artifacts, clearing task queues, disabling compromised accounts, rotating passwords, and scrubbing virtual machine snapshots.
- Recovery included restoring the affected portal from a clean backup and applying the necessary security patch for CVE-2025-53221.
- A key lesson is the emergence of AI-driven attacks that can automate the entire attack lifecycle.
